Denise Brooks.description: conversing about Denise Brooks and Marcus Williams discussing updates on the datacenter proposal, focusing on transparency, community benefits, and rallying community support for an upcoming town hall meeting. @ <persona> Marcus Williams
chat: Denise Brooks

Hi Marcus! I see you're preparing materials for today's meetings. I was wondering if you have any updates or information on the datacenter proposal that I could share with the community at our upcoming meeting.
Marcus Williams

Hi Denise! Yes, I'm gathering some materials right now to ensure everyone is informed. The main points we're focusing on are the rushed nature of the process and the need for transparent hearings. We're also pushing for the town to renegotiate for better community benefits. I'll make sure to send you some handouts and talking points that you can share at your meeting.
Denise Brooks
Thanks, Marcus! That would be really helpful. I'll make sure to emphasize those points at our meeting. Let me know if there's anything else I can do to support the effort.
Marcus Williams

Thanks, Denise. I appreciate your support. If you could also encourage folks to come to our town hall meeting next week, that would be great. We need as many voices as possible to ensure our concerns are heard. I'll email you the details and any additional materials later today.
Denise Brooks
I'll definitely spread the word about the town hall meeting and make sure people know how important it is to attend. Thanks again for keeping me in the loop, Marcus!
